source: blender/out/frozen_FL.blend (finished state, look layer day) via blender/web_hero (bake_lightmaps.py, ground_tiles.py, render_panorama.py, export_web.py, node/post_glb.mjs)
frame: glTF y-up = app frame: x east, y up, z south, metres, origin at the pitch centre

codecs.lightmaps: KTX2 UASTC + RDO + zstd (light: sRGB, ao: linear)
codecs.colour: KTX2 ETC1S (albedo maps, shield paint, impostor atlas, ground tiles)
codecs.panorama: OpenEXR half float, DWAB (8K); Radiance HDR (2048)

lightmaps: Baked materials carry extras.talanta_lightmap: move emissiveMap to lightMap (texture.channel = texCoord), emissive black, lightMapIntensity = intensity. KTX2Loader required.
labels: Estimated geometry and colours (parameter ledger). Traffic and any people are Visualization. No reference frame is used as a texture.

curve.output: display-encoded value (the scene display device), 0..1, float, through Blender's OCIO config (PyOpenColorIO)
curve.check: max difference to Blender save_render 8-bit: 0.00196 (look), 0.00195 (no look)

compositor.order: saturation and warm gain on scene-linear before the view transform (warmth fades in over display-equivalent luminance warmth_rise and out over warmth_fall); fog glow glare (glare, glare_threshold) and streaks; lens dispersion; vignette and grain last
compositor.not_in_web: volumetric haze and the mist-pass aerial haze of the stills (the references are rendered without haze)

look.source: blender/web_hero/measure_look.py (lookdev.py STRENGTHS after hero_artistic.prepare, render_cycles.py presets)
